objectives.statement: Recognize and choose liten, lita, or lite for indefinite singular nouns.
Use lille with definite singular nouns.
Use små for plural nouns, including definite plural nouns.
Find and fix incorrect forms of liten in short noun phrases and sentences.

notes: Must teach the high-frequency irregular adjective liten: liten/lita/lite in indefinite singular, lille in definite singular, and små in plural and definite plural. Contrast with regular adjective agreement covered in adjective_agreement and keep the focus on memorising these irregular forms.
